```diff
+    def execute_federated_query(self, question: str, max_hops: int = 2, verify: bool = True,
+                                max_augmentation: Optional[int] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Phase 3: a natural-language question, unfolded over the same GAV mapping
+        (schema_mapping.json, section "phase3") into one subquery per database view,
+        executed by each database on its own machine, which also discovers its own
+        context through its FK-PK relationships (SCORE: integration/federation/score_context.py).
+        The local contexts are merged into result["query_context"] (context_aggregator.py), which
+        then drives the search of every source's documents; result["integrated"] is the combined
+        structured + unstructured answer (retrieval.py).
+        """
+        from integration.federation.coordinator import federated_query
+        return federated_query(question, max_hops=max_hops, verify=verify,
+                               max_augmentation=max_augmentation, top_n=top_n)
```

### `schema/schema_db1.sql`

```diff
diff --git a/schema/schema_db1.sql b/schema/schema_db1.sql
index 9c05ee8..2877825 100644
--- a/schema/schema_db1.sql
+++ b/schema/schema_db1.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,14 @@
 -- DB1: Purchase and Scan Registry
 -- Records scan and purchase events at point of sale.
 -- Integration attribute: scan_code
+--
+-- Phase 3: the retail POS now keeps 7 related tables. A medicine sold at a
+-- pharmacy is described by its item-master row (retail_medicines), the goods
+-- received note that brought it in (stock_receipts), the shelf stock
+-- (inventory), the checkout scans (purchase_events) and the terminal that read
+-- it (pos_terminals), all hanging off the pharmacy (vendors).
+-- No existing table gained or lost a column; purchase_events only gained the
+-- foreign key on its existing device_id column.
 
 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
 
@@ -20,6 +28,19 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vendors (
     CONSTRAINT chk_vendor_id CHECK (vendor_id LIKE 'VND-%')
 );
 
+-- 4. (Phase 3) POS terminals: the till or camera that read a pack
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pos_terminals (
+    device_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    vendor_id           TEXT,
+    terminal_model      TEXT,
+    scanner_type        TEXT CHECK(scanner_type IN ('laser','imager_2d','camera','nfc','keyboard')),
+    firmware_version    TEXT,
+    installed_on        DATE,
+    registration_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registered'
+                        CHECK(registration_status IN ('registered','auto_registered','decommissioned')),
+    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id)
+);
+
 -- 2. Purchase events table: point of sale scans
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_events (
     event_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
@@ -41,7 +62,9 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS purchase_events (
     -- (path under dashboard/). Used as matching evidence for a damaged scan_code.
     label_text       TEXT,
     label_image      TEXT,
-    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id)
+    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id),
+    -- Phase 3: the terminal that made the scan
+    FOREIGN KEY (device_id) REFERENCES pos_terminals(device_id)
 );
 
 -- 3. Scan anomaly log: duplicate or impossible scan patterns
@@ -55,8 +78,85 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS scan_anomaly_log (
     resolved         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
 );
 
+-- 5. (Phase 3) Retail item master: the medicines this pharmacy network stocks,
+-- as keyed in by the pharmacy when the item was first received.
+-- item_code is the serialised medicine id printed on the pack: the same business
+-- identifier DB2 calls batch_serial, DB3 product_uid and DB4 complaint_item_ref.
+-- Sales are not tied to this table by a foreign key on purchase_events.scan_code,
+-- on purpose: a scanned code can be damaged (Phase 2), and a counterfeit code has
+-- no master row at all. Sales join it on scan_code = item_code.
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS retail_medicines (
+    item_code        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    brand_name       TEXT NOT NULL,
+    generic_name     TEXT,
+    strength         TEXT,
+    pack_size        TEXT,
+    batch_number     TEXT,
+    expiry_date      DATE,
+    mrp_inr          REAL CHECK(mrp_inr IS NULL OR mrp_inr >= 0),
+    schedule_class   TEXT CHECK(schedule_class IN ('OTC','H','H1','X')),
+    manufacturer_id  TEXT,     -- business id of the maker (DB3 manufacturers.manufacturer_id)
+    added_on         DATE
+);
+
+-- 6. (Phase 3) Goods received notes: stock arriving at a pharmacy from a distributor
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS stock_receipts (
+    receipt_id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    vendor_id               TEXT NOT NULL,
+    item_code               TEXT NOT NULL,
+    supplier_distributor_id TEXT,     -- business id (DB2 distributors.distributor_id)
+    supplier_dispatch_ref   TEXT,     -- business id (DB2 distribution_batches.batch_id)
+    invoice_no              TEXT,
+    received_on             DATE NOT NULL,
+    quantity_received       INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_received >= 0),
+    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (item_code) REFERENCES retail_medicines(item_code)
+);
+
+-- 7. (Phase 3) Inventory: stock on hand per pharmacy and medicine
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
+    inventory_id      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    vendor_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
+    item_code         TEXT NOT NULL,
+    quantity_on_hand  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(quantity_on_hand >= 0),
+    reorder_level     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
+    shelf_location    TEXT,
+    last_receipt_id   TEXT,
+    last_stock_take   DATE,
+    UNIQUE (vendor_id, item_code),
+    FOREIGN KEY (vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors(vendor_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (item_code) REFERENCES retail_medicines(item_code),
+    FOREIGN KEY (last_receipt_id) REFERENCES stock_receipts(receipt_id)
+);
+
 -- Indexes
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pe_scan_code   ON purchase_events(scan_code);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pe_vendor_id   ON purchase_events(vendor_id);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pe_timestamp   ON purchase_events(scan_timestamp);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pe_anomaly     ON purchase_events(anomaly_flag);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pe_device      ON purchase_events(device_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_term_vendor    ON pos_terminals(vendor_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sr_vendor      ON stock_receipts(vendor_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sr_item        ON stock_receipts(item_code);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_inv_item       ON inventory(item_code);
+
+-- Phase 3 integrity triggers. FK enforcement is off for the Phase 1/2 code paths
+-- (they deliberately store noisy references), so a scan from a terminal nobody
+-- registered yet registers it instead of leaving a dangling reference.
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_pe_register_terminal_ins
+AFTER INSERT ON purchase_events
+WHEN NEW.device_id IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO pos_terminals (device_id, vendor_id, registration_status, installed_on)
+    VALUES (NEW.device_id, (SELECT vendor_id FROM vendors WHERE vendor_id = NEW.vendor_id),
+            'auto_registered', date('now'));
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_pe_register_terminal_upd
+AFTER UPDATE OF device_id ON purchase_events
+WHEN NEW.device_id IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO pos_terminals (device_id, vendor_id, registration_status, installed_on)
+    VALUES (NEW.device_id, (SELECT vendor_id FROM vendors WHERE vendor_id = NEW.vendor_id),
+            'auto_registered', date('now'));
+END;
```

### `schema/schema_db2.sql`

```diff
diff --git a/schema/schema_db2.sql b/schema/schema_db2.sql
index cbd01fe..aad3daf 100644
--- a/schema/schema_db2.sql
+++ b/schema/schema_db2.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,14 @@
 -- DB2: Distributor and Supplier Ledger
 -- Tracks shipments from manufacturers to retail vendors.
 -- Integration attribute: batch_serial
+--
+-- Phase 3: the distributor ERP now keeps 7 related tables. A shipment of a
+-- medicine (distribution_batches, one row per shipment line) is described by
+-- the distributor that carried it, the warehouse it left from (warehouses),
+-- the cold-chain data logger packed with it (cold_chain_loggers) and every
+-- reading that logger took (temperature_logs).
+-- No existing table gained or lost a column; distribution_batches only gained
+-- a composite foreign key on its existing (distributor_id, source_warehouse).
 
 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
 
@@ -22,6 +30,24 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS distributors (
     CONSTRAINT chk_dist_id CHECK (distributor_id LIKE 'DIST-%')
 );
 
+-- 5. (Phase 3) Warehouses: the distributor's storage locations, as named on its
+-- dispatch notes. A location written on a note but never licensed ('Unregistered
+-- godown', '?') is kept with verification_status = 'unregistered': that is
+-- evidence, not an error to clean away.
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS warehouses (
+    warehouse_id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    distributor_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
+    warehouse_name          TEXT NOT NULL,
+    city                    TEXT,
+    drug_license_no         TEXT,
+    cold_storage            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cold_storage IN (0,1)),
+    cold_storage_capacity_l REAL,
+    verification_status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registered'
+                            CHECK(verification_status IN ('registered','unregistered','auto_registered')),
+    UNIQUE (distributor_id, warehouse_name),
+    FOREIGN KEY (distributor_id) REFERENCES distributors(distributor_id)
+);
+
 -- 2. Distribution batches: per-item shipment records
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS distribution_batches (
     batch_id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
@@ -43,7 +69,9 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS distribution_batches (
                           CHECK(status IN ('dispatched','in_transit','delivered','returned','lost','damaged')),
     discrepancy_noted     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     discrepancy_details   TEXT,
-    FOREIGN KEY (distributor_id) REFERENCES distributors(distributor_id)
+    FOREIGN KEY (distributor_id) REFERENCES distributors(distributor_id),
+    -- Phase 3: the warehouse the shipment left from (NULL source_warehouse = not recorded)
+    FOREIGN KEY (distributor_id, source_warehouse) REFERENCES warehouses(distributor_id, warehouse_name)
 );
 
 -- 3. Distributor to vendor authorization contracts
@@ -70,8 +98,55 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS return_log (
     notes           TEXT
 );
 
+-- 6. (Phase 3) Cold-chain data loggers: one logger travels with each shipment
+-- that must be kept within a temperature band. The setpoints are the storage
+-- band the distributor was instructed to hold for that medicine.
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cold_chain_loggers (
+    logger_id        TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    batch_id         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    logger_serial    TEXT NOT NULL,
+    profile          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(profile IN ('refrigerated_2_8C','frozen','ambient_controlled')),
+    setpoint_min_c   REAL NOT NULL,
+    setpoint_max_c   REAL NOT NULL,
+    activated_at     DATETIME,
+    deactivated_at   DATETIME,
+    CHECK (setpoint_min_c < setpoint_max_c),
+    FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES distribution_batches(batch_id)
+);
+
+-- 7. (Phase 3) Temperature readings taken by a logger during the journey
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS temperature_logs (
+    reading_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    logger_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
+    recorded_at    DATETIME NOT NULL,
+    temperature_c  REAL NOT NULL,
+    location_type  TEXT CHECK(location_type IN ('warehouse','in_transit','delivery')),
+    excursion      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(excursion IN (0,1)),
+    FOREIGN KEY (logger_id) REFERENCES cold_chain_loggers(logger_id)
+);
+
 -- Indexes
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_db_batch_serial   ON distribution_batches(batch_serial);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_db_distributor    ON distribution_batches(distributor_id);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_db_vendor         ON distribution_batches(destination_vendor_id);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_db_status         ON distribution_batches(status);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_db_warehouse      ON distribution_batches(distributor_id, source_warehouse);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tl_logger         ON temperature_logs(logger_id);
+
+-- Phase 3 integrity trigger: a dispatch note naming a location the ERP has not
+-- seen before records that location, so the foreign key never dangles.
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_db_register_warehouse_ins
+AFTER INSERT ON distribution_batches
+WHEN NEW.source_warehouse IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO warehouses (warehouse_id, distributor_id, warehouse_name, verification_status)
+    VALUES ('WH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.distributor_id, NEW.source_warehouse, 'auto_registered');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_db_register_warehouse_upd
+AFTER UPDATE OF distributor_id, source_warehouse ON distribution_batches
+WHEN NEW.source_warehouse IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO warehouses (warehouse_id, distributor_id, warehouse_name, verification_status)
+    VALUES ('WH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.distributor_id, NEW.source_warehouse, 'auto_registered');
+END;
```

### `schema/schema_db3.sql`

```diff
diff --git a/schema/schema_db3.sql b/schema/schema_db3.sql
index ef7a322..1c162dc 100644
--- a/schema/schema_db3.sql
+++ b/schema/schema_db3.sql
@@ -1,6 +1,14 @@
 -- DB3: Manufacturer Product Registry
 -- Authoritative catalog of genuine products registered by licensed manufacturers.
 -- Integration attribute: product_uid
+--
+-- Phase 3: the registry now keeps 7 related tables. A registered medicine batch
+-- (products, one row per serialised batch) is described by its molecule
+-- (molecules), its maker (manufacturers), the plant that made it
+-- (manufacturing_sites), the production run (production_records) and the
+-- quality-control release certificate (batch_release_certs).
+-- No existing table gained or lost a column; products only gained a foreign
+-- key on its existing generic_name column.
 
 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
 
@@ -25,6 +33,18 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS manufacturers (
     CONSTRAINT chk_mfg_id CHECK (manufacturer_id LIKE 'MFG-%')
 );
 
+-- 5. (Phase 3) Molecules: the active ingredient a product is a brand of
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS molecules (
+    molecule_id          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    generic_name         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    atc_code             TEXT,
+    therapeutic_class    TEXT,
+    schedule_class       TEXT CHECK(schedule_class IN ('OTC','H','H1','X')),
+    cold_chain_required  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(cold_chain_required IN (0,1)),
+    registration_status  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registered'
+                         CHECK(registration_status IN ('registered','auto_registered'))
+);
+
 -- 2. Products table: catalog of registered SKU items
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
     product_uid          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
@@ -52,6 +72,8 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS products (
     unit_cost_kes        REAL,
     msrp_kes             REAL,
     FOREIGN KEY (manufacturer_id) REFERENCES manufacturers(manufacturer_id),
+    -- Phase 3: the molecule this product is a brand of
+    FOREIGN KEY (generic_name) REFERENCES molecules(generic_name),
     CONSTRAINT chk_dates CHECK (manufacture_date < expiry_date)
 );
 
@@ -81,6 +103,35 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS batch_release_certs (
     FOREIGN KEY (product_uid) REFERENCES products(product_uid)
 );
 
+-- 6. (Phase 3) Manufacturing sites: licensed plants of each manufacturer
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS manufacturing_sites (
+    site_id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    manufacturer_id      TEXT NOT NULL,
+    site_name            TEXT NOT NULL,
+    city                 TEXT,
+    state                TEXT,
+    site_license_no      TEXT UNIQUE,
+    gmp_status           TEXT CHECK(gmp_status IN ('compliant','under_review','non_compliant')),
+    last_gmp_inspection  DATE,
+    FOREIGN KEY (manufacturer_id) REFERENCES manufacturers(manufacturer_id)
+);
+
+-- 7. (Phase 3) Production records: the manufacturing run behind a registered batch
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS production_records (
+    production_id     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    product_uid       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    site_id           TEXT NOT NULL,
+    batch_number      TEXT NOT NULL,
+    production_line   TEXT,
+    started_on        DATE,
+    completed_on      DATE,
+    batch_size_units  INTEGER CHECK(batch_size_units IS NULL OR batch_size_units > 0),
+    yield_percent     REAL CHECK(yield_percent IS NULL OR (yield_percent >= 0 AND yield_percent <= 100)),
+    api_lot_no        TEXT,
+    FOREIGN KEY (product_uid) REFERENCES products(product_uid),
+    FOREIGN KEY (site_id) REFERENCES manufacturing_sites(site_id)
+);
+
 -- Indexes
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_uid        ON products(product_uid);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_mfg        ON products(manufacturer_id);
@@ -88,3 +139,29 @@ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_category   ON products(category);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_expiry     ON products(expiry_date);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_recalled   ON products(is_recalled);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_reg        ON products(registration_no);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prod_generic    ON products(generic_name);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cert_product    ON batch_release_certs(product_uid);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_site_mfg        ON manufacturing_sites(manufacturer_id);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_prodrec_site    ON production_records(site_id);
+
+-- Phase 3 integrity triggers: registering a product with a molecule the
+-- registry has not catalogued yet catalogues it, so the foreign key never dangles.
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_prod_register_molecule_ins
+AFTER INSERT ON products
+WHEN NEW.generic_name IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO molecules (molecule_id, generic_name, atc_code, therapeutic_class,
+                                     cold_chain_required, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('MOL-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.generic_name, NEW.atc_code, NEW.category,
+            CASE WHEN NEW.requires_cold_chain = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 'auto_registered');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_prod_register_molecule_upd
+AFTER UPDATE OF generic_name ON products
+WHEN NEW.generic_name IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO molecules (molecule_id, generic_name, atc_code, therapeutic_class,
+                                     cold_chain_required, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('MOL-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.generic_name, NEW.atc_code, NEW.category,
+            CASE WHEN NEW.requires_cold_chain = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 'auto_registered');
+END;
```

### `schema/schema_db4.sql`

```diff
diff --git a/schema/schema_db4.sql b/schema/schema_db4.sql
index 922b943..91865a4 100644
--- a/schema/schema_db4.sql
+++ b/schema/schema_db4.sql
@@ -1,9 +1,33 @@
 -- DB4: Ministry of Consumer Affairs Report Database
 -- Tracks complaints, regulatory blacklists, and forensic lab tests.
 -- Integration attribute: complaint_item_ref
+--
+-- Phase 3: the ministry now keeps 7 related tables. What the regulator knows
+-- about a medicine is spread over complaints, laboratory reports, the blacklist,
+-- public alerts and recall notices, each tied to the authority and officer that
+-- acted on it (regulatory_authorities, ministry_officers).
+-- The ministry keeps no medicine master of its own: it refers to medicines by the
+-- item reference written on the complaint or order (often noisy, Phase 2), and
+-- DB3 is the register of record. No existing table gained or lost a column;
+-- ministry_officers and public_alerts only gained foreign keys on existing columns.
 
 PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;
 
+-- 6. (Phase 3) Regulatory authorities: the bodies officers belong to and that
+-- issue alerts and recalls, with their place in the government hierarchy
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS regulatory_authorities (
+    authority_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    authority_name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+    short_name           TEXT,
+    authority_type       TEXT CHECK(authority_type IN ('ministry','drug_regulator','laboratory',
+                                                       'consumer_protection','quasi_judicial','helpline')),
+    jurisdiction         TEXT,
+    parent_authority_id  TEXT,
+    registration_status  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'registered'
+                         CHECK(registration_status IN ('registered','auto_registered')),
+    FOREIGN KEY (parent_authority_id) REFERENCES regulatory_authorities(authority_id)
+);
+
 -- 1. Ministry officers table
 CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ministry_officers (
     officer_id   TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
@@ -12,7 +36,9 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ministry_officers (
     rank         TEXT,
     email        TEXT UNIQUE,
     phone        TEXT,
-    active       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
+    active       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+    -- Phase 3: the department is the authority the officer serves
+    FOREIGN KEY (department) REFERENCES regulatory_authorities(authority_name)
 );
 
 -- 2. Complaints table: reports of suspected fake or substandard items
@@ -88,7 +114,33 @@ CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public_alerts (
     channel      TEXT,
     message      TEXT NOT NULL,
     issued_by    TEXT,
-    active       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
+    active       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
+    -- Phase 3: the authority that issued the alert
+    FOREIGN KEY (issued_by) REFERENCES regulatory_authorities(authority_name)
+);
+
+-- 7. (Phase 3) Recall notices: statutory recall orders for a medicine batch,
+-- tied to the complaint and laboratory report that justified them and the
+-- public alert that announced them
+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recall_notices (
+    recall_id           TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
+    authority_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
+    issuing_officer_id  TEXT,
+    item_ref            TEXT NOT NULL,     -- medicine id as gazetted (business id, DB3 product_uid)
+    batch_ref           TEXT,              -- manufacturer batch number as gazetted
+    manufacturer_ref    TEXT,              -- business id (DB3 manufacturers.manufacturer_id)
+    recall_class        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(recall_class IN ('I','II','III')),
+    reason              TEXT NOT NULL,
+    issued_on           DATE NOT NULL,
+    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active','completed','withdrawn')),
+    complaint_id        TEXT,
+    lab_report_id       TEXT,
+    alert_id            TEXT,
+    FOREIGN KEY (authority_id) REFERENCES regulatory_authorities(authority_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (issuing_officer_id) REFERENCES ministry_officers(officer_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (complaint_id) REFERENCES complaints(complaint_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (lab_report_id) REFERENCES lab_reports(lab_report_id),
+    FOREIGN KEY (alert_id) REFERENCES public_alerts(alert_id)
 );
 
 -- Indexes
@@ -99,3 +151,37 @@ CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comp_date      ON complaints(complaint_date);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bl_item_ref    ON ministry_blacklist(item_ref);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bl_active      ON ministry_blacklist(active);
 CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_item_ref   ON lab_reports(item_ref);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_recall_item    ON recall_notices(item_ref);
+CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_officer_dept   ON ministry_officers(department);
+
+-- Phase 3 integrity triggers: an officer posted to, or an alert issued by, an
+-- authority not yet on file records that authority, so the foreign key never dangles.
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_officer_register_authority_ins
+AFTER INSERT ON ministry_officers
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO regulatory_authorities (authority_id, authority_name, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('AUTH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.department, 'auto_registered');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_officer_register_authority_upd
+AFTER UPDATE OF department ON ministry_officers
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO regulatory_authorities (authority_id, authority_name, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('AUTH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.department, 'auto_registered');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_alert_register_authority_ins
+AFTER INSERT ON public_alerts
+WHEN NEW.issued_by IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO regulatory_authorities (authority_id, authority_name, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('AUTH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.issued_by, 'auto_registered');
+END;
+
+CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trg_alert_register_authority_upd
+AFTER UPDATE OF issued_by ON public_alerts
+WHEN NEW.issued_by IS NOT NULL
+BEGIN
+    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO regulatory_authorities (authority_id, authority_name, registration_status)
+    VALUES ('AUTH-AUTO-' || upper(hex(randomblob(4))), NEW.issued_by, 'auto_registered');
+END;
```
